originalTitle: MiMo-V2.5 系列推理全链路优化：将 Hybrid SWA 效率推向极致
title: MiMo-V2.5 Series Inference Full-Link Optimization: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Extreme
oneSentenceSummary: This article details the engineering optimization practices in the full inference pipeline of Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5 series models, systematically translating the theoretical efficiency advantages of the Hybrid SWA architecture into production reality.
summary: The article focuses on the MiMo-V2.5 series models (integrating Hybrid SWA, MoE, and multimodal Encoder), documenting the full-link engineering practices from KVCache management, hierarchical caching systems, SWA prefix caching trees, scheduling strategies, Prefill/Decode execution pipelines, to multimodal optimization. Core highlights include: splitting KVCache into Full Attention and SWA dual pools to achieve strict O(W) storage constraints, improving capacity efficiency by approximately 7x; designing a SWA-aware prefix caching tree to resolve the false hit issue of traditional RadixAttention in SWA mode; developing the self-owned GCache high-performance distributed cache, leveraging co-located GPU machines to achieve zero additional storage cost; implementing LLM-Router for KVCache affinity scheduling, boosting L2 cache hit rate by 25%; optimizing Prefill performance through EP reduction, length bucketing, and NUMA conflict fixes; enhancing Decode throughput via full SWA support and PD separation pre-allocation; and multimodal optimizations including EPD separation, GPU preprocessing, and parallel video decoding. Ultimately, the server-side KV Cache hit rate averages 93%, exceeding 95% in personal user scenarios.

mainPoints.point: The Hybrid SWA architecture reduces KVCache storage to approximately 1/7 of Full Attention by mixing window attention.
mainPoints.explanation: Of the model's 70 layers, only 10 are Full Attention, while the remaining 60 are SWA with a sliding window size of 128, significantly reducing computation and storage costs in long-context scenarios.

mainPoints.point: The dual-pool KVCache design is key to unlocking the structural advantages of Hybrid SWA.
mainPoints.explanation: KVCache is split into two independent pools for Full Attention and SWA, managed physically separately while exposing a single sequence view logically, achieving strict O(W) storage constraints and approximately 7x capacity efficiency improvement.

mainPoints.point: The SWA-aware prefix caching tree resolves the false hit issue of traditional RadixAttention in SWA mode.
mainPoints.explanation: A window-safe length matching rule is introduced to ensure the validity of KV in hit segments; eviction paths are tied to request lifecycles; nodes simultaneously carry both Full Attention and SWA indices for efficient reuse.

mainPoints.point: The self-developed GCache distributed cache achieves zero additional storage cost by co-locating with GPU machines.
mainPoints.explanation: GCache takes over part of the GPU machines' memory and NVMe SSDs, supporting memory/disk/remote multi-level caching with RDMA communication and full-link zero-copy capability, ensuring availability with a single replica.

mainPoints.point: Multimodal inference achieves a 2x Encoder throughput improvement through EPD separation, GPU preprocessing, and parallel video decoding.
mainPoints.explanation: Supports asynchronous replication of multimodal Embedding data with parallel inference, Encoder data parallelism, and cross-request group batching. Image preprocessing is moved to the GPU, and video decoding is parallelized via multi-threading, reducing 1-hour video processing latency from 156s to 23s.

keyQuotes: The core idea of Hybrid SWA is to hierarchically mix local window attention with global attention: the vast majority of layers compute attention only within a local window, while only a few key layers retain a global perspective.
Theoretical architectural advantages do not naturally translate into efficiency gains in real online systems.
SWA compressing KV volume to 1/7 is a capacity-level gain, while the hit rate is a reuse-level gain. The product of the two determines the actual computational cost curve of the prefill phase.
The eviction of KVCache fundamentally stems from storage capacity constraints. When capacity approaches saturation, the system must prioritize retaining the KV Cache generated by new requests.
The inference efficiency of the MiMo-V2.5 series models is not the result of a single breakthrough in one area, but rather the outcome of multi-dimensional collaborative optimization.
